welcome.institutions_description: A platform that connects our academic community.

institutional.about_lead: SGEA is the Event and Activity Management System of the Faculty of Pure and Natural Sciences at UMSA: a formal academic portal to publish, organize, and join learning experiences.
institutional.about_body_1: We were created to unify the dissemination of congresses, courses, symposia, and academic activities in one trusted space. The university community and external participants can explore the offer, pre-register, track progress, and obtain certificates with institutional backing.
institutional.about_body_2: The system coordinates roles for coordination, lecturing, logistics, and students, with clear processes for enrollment, attendance, assessment, and certification aligned with Universidad Mayor de San Andrés standards.
institutional.commitment_body: Every activity published in SGEA follows a verifiable academic process: dates, modalities, quotas, materials, and outcomes stay centralized for the community.
institutional.mission_body: Enable end-to-end management of academic events and activities, offering reliable information, simple enrollment, and transparent follow-up for students, faculty, and organizers.
institutional.vision_body: Become the FCPN-UMSA reference platform for disseminating and administering learning experiences through agile, secure, and sustainable digital processes.
institutional.values_body: Academic rigor, operational transparency, community inclusion, continuous improvement, and respect for the institutional identity of UMSA and FCPN.
institutional.org_lead: SGEA operates within the institutional framework of UMSA and FCPN, with teams that coordinate publication, teaching, and logistics for every activity.
institutional.org_umsa_body: Governing institution that validates the academic nature of the platform and safeguards the quality of published learning processes.
institutional.org_fcpn_title: Faculty of Pure and Natural Sciences
institutional.org_fcpn_body: Academic unit responsible for operating the system, engaging departments, and promoting scientific events and continuing education.
institutional.org_sgea_body: Coordinators, lecturers, logistics staff, and technical support work through specialized portals to publish, teach, track attendance, and issue certificates.
institutional.services_title: What you will find on the platform
institutional.service_events_body: Browse congresses, symposia, and programs with dates, venues, and official details.
institutional.service_courses_body: Access in-person, virtual, or hybrid modalities, with materials and classroom access when available.
institutional.service_certs_body: Receive digital participation or approval certificates according to each course requirements.
institutional.service_community_body: Connect students, faculty, and organizers in a single enrollment and follow-up flow.
institutional.location_lead: SGEA is managed from the UMSA academic environment in La Paz. Activities may take place on campus, at partner venues, or online depending on each event.
institutional.location_hours: Monday to Friday, during the faculty’s administrative hours.
